help.tips[0].examples[0].en: If everyone ate less meat, emissions would fall. Admittedly that's unrealistic, but a start would be possible.
help.tips[0].examples[1].en: While some demand a ban, others rely on voluntary action.
help.tips[0].check.whyEn: fordern is at the end, so a conjunction is needed, and setting two groups against each other is a contrast: während.
help.tips[0].en.text: Wenn wir …, würden wir … · Zwar …, aber … · Während die einen …, … die anderen … · Deshalb sollte man … in Betracht ziehen. Four moves per topic.
help.tips[0].en.title: Hypothesise, concede, contrast, decide
help.tips[1].examples[0].en: On the basis of current studies, politicians should take measures.
help.tips[1].examples[1].en: As a result of climate change one should also consider new technologies.
help.tips[1].check.whyEn: der hohen Kosten is a genitive noun phrase, not a clause, so it needs the genitive preposition aufgrund (because of).
help.tips[1].en.text: aufgrund der Studien, infolge des Klimawandels, eine Maßnahme ergreifen, zur Verfügung stehen — one or two per answer sound precise without sounding stiff.
help.tips[1].en.title: Formal register on purpose
help.tips[2].examples[0].en: Overall I'm in favour, even if I understand the concerns.
help.tips[2].examples[1].en: Although the costs are high, for me the advantages prevail.
help.tips[2].check.whyEn: auch wenn concedes a point while keeping the verdict, and as a subordinating conjunction it sends ist to the end.
help.tips[2].en.text: Insgesamt überwiegen für mich die Vorteile, auch wenn die Kosten nicht zu unterschätzen sind. — concession inside the conclusion.
help.tips[2].en.title: End on a balanced verdict
help.hookEn: Argue a climate question like a thoughtful adult: imagine outcomes, grant the other side a point, contrast views and reach a verdict.
help.introEn: The closing conversation of this module — and of this stage of the course — in your own AI assistant with voice on: a differentiated discussion on a scientific or environmental question, with hypotheses about what would happen if, concessions to the other side, contrasts between positions, and formal phrasing. Copy the exercise in, say 'Los geht's', answer in full sentences; the score and corrections come at the end. The tutor listens for: a wenn-hypothesis in the Konjunktiv (present or past), a concession with obwohl / zwar … aber / trotz + Gen, a contrast with während / dagegen, at least one Funktionsverbgefüge (eine Entscheidung treffen, in Betracht ziehen) and one genitive preposition (aufgrund, infolge). It is the kind of discussion you have whenever a real decision is on the table.
help.rememberEn[0]: Wenn … würde; zwar … aber; während … dagegen; in Betracht ziehen.
help.rememberEn[1]: One genitive preposition, one Funktionsverbgefüge per answer.
help.examEn: A discussion like this, with hypotheses and concessions, is what the speaking part of the B2 exam asks for — and what a real debate at work demands.
